headword: {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}
gloss: full-speed sprint; running at full speed

definitions.gloss: full-speed sprint; running at full speed
definitions.explanation: Running as fast as one physically can, exerting maximum effort and speed.

examples.japanese: {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}した→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The athletes sprinted toward the goal at full speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I sprinted to the station at full speed to catch the last train.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧ (full power) and ⟦{疾走|しっそう}→疾走：13666_shissou⟧ (sprint, dash). Describes running as fast as physically possible. Used in both sports contexts and everyday situations where someone runs with maximum effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sprint at full speed
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧: to dash at full speed
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee at full speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疾走|しっそう}→疾走：13666_shissou⟧: sprint, dash — does not necessarily imply maximum effort
- ⟦{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}→全速力：25675_zensokuryoku⟧: full speed — often used adverbially (⟦{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}→全速力：25675_zensokuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧), describes the speed rather than the act of running
- ダッシュ: dash — more casual; often used for short bursts of speed
